hero.subtitle: Technical documentation for Chorn Planet's AI-native platform
hero.body: This technology page acts as a planning document for Chorn Planet's future technical ecosystem, connecting AI platform development, technical expertise pages, cloud operations, web systems, and system capability layers into one practical roadmap for delivery and long-term architecture.

items.title: ERP
items.description: Connects finance, inventory, procurement, sales, and operations into a clear business record.

items.title: MES
items.description: Coordinates manufacturing workflows, work orders, quality signals, and production visibility.

items.title: Logic Controller
items.description: Translates process rules into reliable control actions across equipment and connected systems.

items.title: Physical Layer
items.description: Represents machines, sensors, lines, facilities, and the operational environment where data begins.
